justification: Yes. In core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/oned/rss/expanded/decoders/GeneralAppIdDecoder.java the class is 470 lines long and contains about 18 methods, including separate parsers for numeric, alphanumeric, and ISO/IEC 646 modes plus multiple latch-detection helpers and shared buffer/state management. The class centralizes the full bit-level decoding state machine instead of splitting those concerns into smaller parser abstractions; the nearby helper files (CurrentParsingState.java, DecodedNumeric.java, DecodedChar.java, BlockParsedResult.java, DecodedInformation.java, FieldParser.java) are mostly support types, not a decomposition of the core logic.
